posts.meta_description:
1,112 likes, 23 comments - aashnashroff on September 16, 2026: "AD This New England trip belongs on your USA Bucket List! 🇺🇸🦞 

If charming coastal towns, beautiful blooming hydrangeas, unbelievable architecture & ridiculously pretty views sound like your kind of trip, save this route!

📍 Start in Boston, Massachusetts
🌊 Make your way to Newport, Rhode Island for the Cliff Walk, Gilded Age mansions and the dreamiest seaside sunsets
⛴️ Hop over on a ferry to Martha’s Vineyard and wander through the colourful Gingerbread Cottages in Oak Bluffs, a literal fairy tale 
🦞 Head north to Portland, Maine for cobbled streets, cute boutiques, waterfront dinners and a visit to Portland Head Light
🛍️ Stop at Freeport for the L.L.Bean flagship store — and obviously a Boat and Tote
🌲 Finish in Bar Harbor with the beautiful landscapes of Acadia National Park & for Maine’s iconic lobster boat tours where you also get to see the cutest little seals!

@visittheusa @visit_newengland @visitmaine @visitrhodeisland 
#VisitTheUSA #100YearsOnTheRoad".

4,897 likes, 44 comments - aashnashroff on September 11, 2026: "AD Turns out, a couple of hours from Boston on the Amtrak is all it takes to experience a beautiful little slice of Maine 🌊🤍🦞 

Portland gave us exactly the kind of New England day I had pictured. We started with a beautiful lighthouse on the coast, wandering through little boutiques, dinner by the waterfront, and then a quick trip to Freeport the next morning for one very important souvenir 😬

Just another reason I’m completely sold on making New England summers a regular thing! ⛵️

@visittheusa @visit_newengland @visitmaine
#VisitTheUSA #100YearsOnTheRoad".
